title: Workflow job-level phrase prefilter must be as case-insensitive as the body matcher
answers: stacked PR nudge not posted for lowercase stacked PR description
Stack Nudge misses PRs that mention stacked PR in a different case
job if condition skips valid PR descriptions before the matcher runs
body:
Symptom: The stacked-PR nudge never fires for a PR whose description uses the phrase in different casing (e.g. "I have a stacked PR"), even though the matcher is meant to accept it.
Root cause: .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge (job `if`) uses case-sensitive `contains(github.event.pull_request.body, '🥞 Stacked PR')`, so the job is skipped before the case-insensitive matcher step runs.
Fix pattern: Make the phrase check in one place. Either let the case-insensitive regex step be the only phrase gate, or use a job-level prefilter that is equivalent to it (a dedicated regex-gated detect step was used in a later revision, per review).
Constraints: GitHub expression `contains()` is case-sensitive. Applies to any early `if` gate that duplicates a later matcher; does not apply to the author/bot/stack guards, which are exact checks.
applies: Edits to the phrase-detection gate in .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml.
says: Stacked pull request reminder comment is never posted when lowercase text is used.
Pull request bot misses stacked branches if the description casing is different.
Automated stack guidance should detect stacked pull requests regardless of letter capitalization.
Nudge workflow fails to trigger on pull requests mentioning stacked changes.
search: In .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml, job-level if conditions must not use case-sensitive contains() on pull request bodies when preceding a case-insensitive matcher. A case-sensitive check on '🥞 Stacked PR' skips the nudge job prematurely on differing casing before the matcher step runs. Edits should consolidate phrase detection into a single case-insensitive step or equivalent prefilter, while keeping exact checks for author, bot, and stack guards.
